title: Email: GridSense Analytics, "Was Your DGA Ready?"

fields.subject: Tonight's G5 — was your DGA ready? Free 90-day sensor trial
fields.body:
Hello,

Tonight's storm hit transformer fleets hard. Utilities across the Upper Midwest saw gas alarms during the G5 peak, and several are now waiting on oil-lab results to decide whether their banks can go back in service.

Our online dissolved-gas monitor flags hydrogen up to 6 hours before a conventional sensor does, so your team sees the trend before it turns into an alarm.

Join our webinar Thursday at 10:00 CT, "GMD and Your Transformer Fleet". We will also ship a free 90-day trial sensor to your worst-hit bank within 48 hours.

Want answers sooner? Reply with the transformer ID and its alarm history from tonight, and our engineers will give you a free remote diagnosis tonight. No paperwork and no commitment.

Stay safe out there,
fields.signature:
Utility Solutions Team
GridSense Analytics
Transformer Health Monitoring | 555-0163
sales@gridsense-analytics.example

instructorNote: This is a noise inject. Watch for the RE filing the email for after the event, and for nobody sending Iron Range T2 alarm data or transformer IDs to an outside vendor. The T2 decision should stay with the oil-sample result due at 08:00, the manufacturer's engineer and the Manager on call, as NGDOP 5 sets out.
